results.description:
Stop snoozing and get out of bed with an alarm clock that makes you prove you’re awake.

When your alarm rings, complete a real wake-up challenge before starting your day. Choose how you want to wake up, from movement and camera challenges to quick mental exercises.

10 WAKE-UP CHALLENGES

• Shake: shake your iPhone until you complete the goal
• Voice: say a positive morning affirmation out loud
• Push-ups: your camera counts completed repetitions on-device
• Squats: your camera counts completed squats
• Object Find: locate an everyday object using on-device vision
• Walk: get out of bed and complete your step goal
• QR Code: scan a code placed in your bathroom, kitchen, or another room
• Math: solve problems on a large, easy-to-use keypad
• Typing: type a phrase correctly to dismiss the alarm
• Memory: remember and repeat a sequence of numbers

YOUR MORNING BRIEFING

After completing your challenge, see today’s weather, your first calendar event, your wake-up streak, and fresh motivation on one screen. Weather and calendar access are optional, processed on-device, and never uploaded.

WIDGETS AND LIVE ACTIVITIES

Keep your next alarm and streak visible with Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, plus a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.

FAIR AND RELIABLE

Every permission-dependent challenge includes a mental backup. If the room is too dark or your steps cannot be counted, you can complete the backup challenge instead.

An emergency dismiss option is always available, so a hardware or permission problem never leaves you trapped with a ringing alarm.

BUILT WITH APPLE’S ALARM SYSTEM

Rise Mission uses Apple’s AlarmKit for a reliable system alarm experience. Scheduled alarms can appear on the Lock Screen and sound even when your iPhone is locked.

FOCUS BEYOND THE MORNING

Stay productive throughout the day with built-in focus tools:

• Timer: set a reliable countdown and add more time when needed
• Pomodoro: move through Focus, Break, and Long Break cycles
• Daily Reminder: optionally schedule a reminder for your focus routine

BUILD A BETTER MORNING ROUTINE

• Maintain your wake-up streak
• Earn achievements for consistent mornings
• Review your alarm and challenge history
• Track completion rate, challenge time, and snooze frequency
• Explore seven-day and thirty-day trends

PERSONALIZED FROM THE START

Rise Mission helps create your first alarm around your wake-up goal, biggest morning obstacle, and preferred challenge. After unlocking Pro, an optional guided tour lets you try challenges, choose an alarm sound, and create your first alarm.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

No account is required. Your alarms, history, streaks, onboarding answers, and settings stay on your iPhone.

Camera frames, voice audio, speech recognition, motion data, weather location, and calendar information are processed on-device. They are never recorded, saved, or uploaded.

Rise Mission uses limited anonymous analytics and purchase-processing services. It does not use IDFA, sell personal data, show third-party advertising, or track you across other companies’ apps and websites.

RISE MISSION PRO

Rise Mission Pro unlocks unlimited alarms, all 10 challenges, every difficulty, Focus Timer, Pomodoro, all alarm sounds, achievements, and complete statistics.

Choose a Weekly or Yearly auto-renewable subscription, or unlock Pro permanently with a one-time Lifetime purchase. Available options and localized prices are displayed before purchase.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when your purchase is confirmed. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. Manage or cancel subscriptions from your Apple Account settings.

Previous Lifetime customers retain full access.

•  Customize Nightstand display colors
•  Sleep Timer

WAKE UP ON TIME: Proper Alarm Settings
• Keep the app open and running always to have your alarm go off and play the sounds you’ve set for ‘Music'.
When your app is open, you can use the volume slider within the app. When the app is in the background, use the device volume to set your volume.

• Make sure your battery is charged and have your notifications turned on before you go to sleep, when the battery level goes below 30% it might not sound. This is due to prevent the device from dying and the alarm not going off.

• Keep your Apple Music available on your device
The music you can select consists of everything you have available on your ‘Apple Music' app on your device. If the music is saved on your iCloud, and not on the device itself, it won’t be available.


NEVER MISS AN ALARM
When you close the app and do not have it running in the background, the alarm will use the device volume instead and play the notification sound system.

The app will close itself automatically after 10 hours of inactivity. This is due to prevent the device from dying and the alarm not going off.

When your device is muted, set to ‘Do Not Disturb’, or your device volume is set to 0, the alarm won’t play properly. It will still show the notification without any sound. This is due to Apple’s restrictions as we are unable to access the app settings when the app is closed, only when it’s open or running in the background.
